name: opencode-go-session-bridge
description: Local lightweight bridge that injects/preserves the x-opencode-session header for coding agents (VS Code Copilot Chat, Trae, ...) talking to OpenCode Go (Zen API). 本地轻量桥接代理：为 coding agent 补齐/保留 x-opencode-session 会话头，透明转发 OpenCode Go。

scripts.test: bash test.sh health && bash test.sh upstream
